content.text:
I've reviewed the transcript, answer key, and record items. Here is my grading.

**Pairings:** All 12 record items map cleanly to key items — no extras, no duplicates. Two key items are missing entirely: Graham's remote-work approval (e4) and the standing no-gains hold Hollis placed on the joint account (a4). Also missing is the action item for Renata to pause the auto-investment herself in the Ferrant app tonight (i7) — record 6 captures the account action (a3), but no separate task item exists for her to execute it.

**Figures:** Clean throughout. Record 4 correctly uses the corrected vested balance $387,240 rather than the initial $430,000. Record 2 uses the accepted $604,000, not the $619,900 list price. Records 1, 3, 5, 6, 12 all match the meeting.

**Dates/owners:** One error — record 11 says the house account and wire instructions are due **September 23, 2026**. Jules explicitly set this at Friday the 23rd *of October*, a week ahead of the October 30 closing (the closing date was itself corrected from a misheard "thirteenth" to the thirtieth). Record 7's September 30 is an acceptable rendering of "before the first."

**Not-actions:** None of the six leaked into the record — the declined Roth conversion, the deferred cabin, the 529 move, backdoor Roth, the 50/50 allocation, and COBRA are all correctly absent.

key_items.note: Base $265,000, sign-on $40,000, relocation $15,000 all match the offer as stated. Omits the $42,760 forfeited unvested profit-sharing and the start/last-day dates, but no figure carried is wrong.
Franklin, TN relocation with $4,150/month lease matches. Omits the 12-month term, Oct 1 lease start, Oct 1 residency and Oct 5 school start, but the figure is right.
Uses the accepted $604,000, not the $619,900 list price, and the $353,800 estimated net. Omits the Oct 30 mail-away close and the $500,000 exclusion covering the ~$128,000 gain.
Not captured. Tollefsrud Mutual's fully-remote approval, Graham keeping his job, and the two-to-three Minnesota days a quarter appear nowhere in the record, though record 7 depends on that approval.
Correctly uses the corrected vested balance of $387,240 rather than Renata's initial $430,000 total-balance figure.

$340,000 into the T-bill ladder is the agreed amount. Does not spell out the four $85,000 rungs, the 3/6/9/12-month tenors, the title-company wire or the money-market remainder, but no figure is wrong.
$2,000 per month paused for October through December matches; the January 2027 resumption is implied by naming only those three months.
Not captured. The hold Hollis had already placed on the joint account, barring sales that realize gains until after October 1, is absent from the record.

Owner Jules and the revised due date of October 6 are both right; the Friday September 18 date was superseded because Grevholm's recordkeeper needs the termination posted. Beneficiary designations are not recorded but no figure or date is wrong.
Correctly reassigned to Jules after Hollis flagged his September 21-25 absence, and due September 25 matches 'end of next week'. Packet contents are summarized rather than itemized.
Graham is the right owner; September 30, 2026 is a faithful rendering of his twice-stated commitment to submit it 'before the first' so the first October check is correct.

$24,500 limit is correct and due on her first day, October 5. Captures the match true-up question; omits the ~$5,500 of remaining room and the 6% auto-enrollment override, but carries no wrong figure.
Both clients as owners and October 31, 2026 match the 30-day window from the October 1 residency date. Williamson County is not named but the substance is there.

Owner Jules is right, but the due date is wrong: recorded as September 23, 2026 when Jules set Friday October 23 to be a week ahead of the October 30 closing. The month is off by one, making the task appear already overdue.

No action item captures this. Record 6 logs the pause as an account action, but Renata's own task to make the change in the Ferrant app tonight, before the October 1 draft, is not recorded as an action item.
